name: Wall
about: A wall whose build-up is not chosen yet: 200 mm thick, up to the floor above. Drawing a wall puts this on the line until it is swapped for the wall it is. Since R144 its height is set by the project's relationships (the storey less the slab and beams above it); with none set, it reaches its full rise. justify says where it sits on its line as drawn: centre, or wholly to its left or its right (the line is then one of its faces). corner (mitre or butt) and priority (the higher carries on) say how it meets others of its kind (R156). Over a wall on the floor below, align says which of that wall's faces it lines up with (line: its own line; centre, left, right), and the Studio's relationships write its offset; with nothing below, offset is yours to set.
